heroes.title: 焰术师 · 烬绯
heroes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CHARACTER, ACTION AND ABILITY CONCEPT SHEET for one playable hero of an original dark fantasy 2D SIDE-VIEW PLATFORM DUEL browser game.
REFERENCE ROLE: the attached moonlit side-view arena is a supporting reference for hand-drawn 2D art, fine gold decoration and clear elemental effects. It is not an edit target. Generate a NEW CHARACTER SHEET.
Make a very detailed, high-resolution wide landscape design board, around 3:2. Polished hand-illustrated dark fantasy, fine contours and painted cel-like shading; NOT a photoreal or 3D render. All heroes are adults with practical battle clothing and distinct class silhouettes.
LAYOUT (consistent across the six-hero set):
Top slim header with exact supplied title and role line.
LEFT 27%: one large full-body three-quarter hero illustration, boots and weapon fully visible, facing right; beneath it two smaller FRONT and BACK design views of the SAME hero, without active spell effects.
UPPER RIGHT 73%: EIGHT clearly readable SIDE-ON action key poses, TWO ROWS OF FOUR, same hero, costume, weapon, scale and facing-right direction. Exact labels: "待机", "奔跑", "起跳", "下落", "落地", "普攻", "受击", "倒地". Each is a single clean silhouette with believable weight, no smeared trails. These are animation key-pose concepts, not a finished sprite atlas. Ground contact lines are thin. Airborne poses must be visibly off-ground. No gore.
LOWER RIGHT: FOUR equal ability-vignette cards in a 2-by-2 grid, each with the exact supplied heading. Show the SAME hero at game scale performing the ability on a neutral SIDE-VIEW stone-platform fragment. Body pose, spell geometry, target and terrain effect all must be legible. A simple grey training dummy is allowed as a target, never as another selectable hero. Give each ability a different casting gesture and effect shape. Small spell-icon insets are welcome.
Neutral charcoal / blue-black textured background, antique-gold thin dividers, cream readable Chinese typography, no long paragraphs, no health bars or HUD, no crowded full arena behind action poses. Leave safe margins. Preserve face, costume, equipment and coloring between every repeat. No logos, watermarks, cropping or invented fine print. The class motion language is as important as clothing and colors. Do not reuse the fire mage's robe, weapon and movements for other professions.

EXACT TITLE: "焰术师 · 烬绯"
EXACT ROLE LINE: "爆发施法 · 灼烧压制"
CHARACTER DESIGN: Adult female fire mage, deep-brown long hair, confident sharp eyes, crimson asymmetric split-tail battle coat over a charcoal fitted tunic and trousers, tall boots, black bracers, sparse antique-gold flame embroidery. Medium-length dark STAFF with open brass fire-cage tip. Preserve the reference arena fire mage's red-and-black identity. Strong flowing angular coat silhouette. Orange, ember-red and cream fire; no blue electricity.
CLASS MOTION LANGUAGE: Explosive forceful casting driven by feet, hips and shoulders. Idle staff angled forward; grounded forward sprint with coat tails streaming; takeoff pushes from one leg; fall knees ready; wide bent-knee landing; basic attack is a sharp forward staff thrust with torso rotation; hit draws staff close; defeated kneels/slumps, staff extinguished. She never calmly floats like the star mage.
FOUR ABILITY CARDS:
1. Exact heading "普攻 · 焰矢": Sharp staff thrust launches a compact tapered horizontal orange FIREBOLT with a clean trail and small impact.
2. Exact heading "Q · 爆燃印": She stamps the staff, drawing an orange telegraph on a CRACKED WOODEN BRIDGE. A small second moment shows an upward burst breaking two planks. Delayed floor burst and destructible terrain.
3. Exact heading "E · 焰跃": Airborne recoil jump: she moves UP-LEFT while a short fire cone blasts DOWN-RIGHT. Make opposing body-motion and fire directions clear.
4. Exact heading "R · 陨火天坠": Two-handed overhead invocation, one molten meteor descending toward a clear bounded orange floor telegraph. Long-windup casting pose; do not hide the hero.
Ensure all eight action key poses and all four skill cards are present and readable. The same adult hero must remain recognizable across all panels.
